title: Going from Place to Place
editorial: The answer depends on the region.

Rent a car for Los Angeles, the California coast, Yosemite and the Vegas/Grand Canyon portion. America was built around cars, and outside a handful of cities pretending otherwise becomes an ideological commitment rather than a travel strategy.
Fly across the country. The distances are too large for a three-week first trip to waste days crossing by road unless the road trip itself is your goal.
In New York and Washington DC, do the opposite: ditch the car and use public transport and your feet.
